method.family_convention: a = larger cluster (dominant garment mass), b = trim

heuristics.skin: hue 9-38 deg, sat > 0.30, val > 0.20 (declared port heuristic); declared Oracolo skin #8a5a3b
heuristics.hair_sat_gated: max-channel distance <= 48/255 from declared hair #0e0c16 AND sat <= 0.35
heuristics.hair_strict_maestro: max-channel distance <= 48/255 from declared hair #0e0c16 (the Maestro's rule; measured to eat the Oracolo's dark violet trim, reported side by side)
heuristics.racket: the Maestro's largest-8-connected-gold-blob rule, closed 9 px then dilated 11 px -- kept so its measured FAILURE on this athlete is a number

sheet_bleed.note: columns belonging to a neighbouring figure's ink on the four-frame sheets; excluded from the colour measurement

hair_rule_sensitivity._why: the declared hair #0e0c16 is only 34/255 from the Oracolo's declared secondary #1a0f38, so the Maestro's hair rule (max-channel <= 48/255) also deletes dark violet garment pixels. The sat-gated rule (<= 0.35 saturation) keeps them. Both are reported.

torso_a.reason: torso_a carries the outfit's identity; the measured #281548 is the declared #38216f in the same hue family (dHue 4.7 deg <= 12 deg), only the 2D shading differs (val 0.28 vs 0.44), so the authored value takes the slot

torso_b.reason: sprite paints this trim as the base's white (#fffeff, sat 0.004); that white is identical in base and signature, so it carries no outfit information, and the declared second colour #29dfff is itself a colour (sat 0.839), so it takes the slot

hip_a.reason: measured modal colour of the region (#281648, 57.4% of the region's garment pixels); the reference declares no colour for this region/family

hip_b.reason: measured modal colour of the region (#593697, 42.6% of the region's garment pixels); the reference declares no colour for this region/family

foot_a.reason: measured modal colour of the region (#2a1947, 69.0% of the region's garment pixels); the reference declares no colour for this region/family

foot_b.reason: sprite paints this trim as the base's white (#fcfafa, sat 0.008); that white is identical in base and signature, so it carries no outfit information, and the declared second colour #29dfff is itself a colour (sat 0.839), so it takes the slot

separation_proposal.weight_note: weights are measured pixel shares of each region x family, averaged over base and signature; a proxy for match-distance legibility, not a perceptual model

family_test_question._note: the two families the SPRITE paints in a region are the garment violet and the base's shared near-white trim; the white has sat < 0.15, so the hue test cannot see it at all (sat_min rejects it). The atlas side of the same question is in `atlas_inventory.two_largest_saturated_families`.

atlas_inventory.note: the anchors and the coverage must come from the mask tool; there is no Oracolo mask in the tree yet, so this inventory is the atlas's own structure, not a coverage measurement

model_measure.note: class is decided by sampling the BAKED texture at each triangle's own UVs and taking the majority of its three corners, weighted by 3D area. UV-seam triangles can straddle two classes; the effect is bounded by the seam texels, and the zone numbers are shares, not absolutes.

mask_lane_cross_check.note: no Oracolo mask directory in the tree; the profile's mask path, anchors and sha256 prefix must stay TODO and the six slots cannot be checked against a mask from here

card_check.note: a preview card that differs from the base card over most of its area is a different illustration, not a recolour; the in-field sprite is the reference for this document.
